research_question: Can the fixed LLM query-expansion implementation complete a development-only engineering canary and produce auditable retrieval diagnostics before any live traffic?
design: paired offline engineering canary; not a confirmatory effectiveness evaluation

baseline.ranking: Hybrid-RRF over BM25, TF-IDF, and SPECTER2 using the seed-title proxy

llm_expansion.ranking: Baseline and expanded-query Hybrid-RRF rankings fused by channel-level RRF

canary_population.query_input: seed_title proxy because all frozen human-query fields are blank
canary_population.effectiveness_claims: forbidden until human queries and independent judgments exist

primary_outcome.name: canary_completion_rate
primary_outcome.definition: Fraction of the 20 development proxy queries with a valid provider expansion and completed paired retrieval run.

secondary_outcomes: baseline versus treatment result overlap at 10 and 20
semantic component availability and degraded reason

sample_size.rationale: all and only the frozen development assignment; no inferential power claim

analysis_plan.missing_expansion: retain in the LLM arm as provider failure
analysis_plan.test_split: must not be read or evaluated

guardrails.raw_query_storage: offline artifact only; proxy titles are already public corpus metadata
